record.field: Summarize Overdue Customer Invoices
summarize_overdue_invoices
Analyze outstanding customer accounts receivable, aging brackets, and payment collection priorities.

Please analyze overdue customer invoices in Odoo: 1. Call `odoo_search_read` on model `account.move` with domain: [["move_type", "=", "out_invoice"], ["state", "=", "posted"], ["payment_state", "in", ["not_paid", "partial"]]] (Optionally filter by partner_id if {partner_id} is provided). Limit results to {limit}. 2. For each overdue invoice, calculate aging days past the `invoice_date_due`. 3. Aggregate total outstanding debt grouped by customer. 4. Produce a prioritized collection action summary highlighting the oldest and largest delinquent accounts.
Analyze Stock Shortages & Reordering Needs
analyze_inventory_shortages
Identify inventory items where forecasted quantities fall below minimum safety levels or sales demands.

Please audit inventory availability and reordering requirements in Odoo: 1. Call `odoo_search_read` on model `product.product` with fields: ["name", "default_code", "qty_available", "virtual_available", "standard_price"] and domain [["type", "=", "consu"], ["virtual_available", "<", 0]] (or storable products). Limit: {limit}. 2. Identify products where forecasted quantity (`virtual_available`) is negative or below threshold. 3. Check active vendor supply links for affected products via `product.supplierinfo`. 4. Provide an executive replenishment proposal including recommended purchase order quantities.
360-Degree Partner Commercial Audit
audit_partner_activity
Comprehensive 360-degree commercial evaluation of a customer or vendor partner.

Perform a comprehensive 360-degree commercial audit for Partner ID {partner_id}: 1. Call `odoo_read` on model `res.partner` for ID [{partner_id}]. 2. Call `odoo_search_read` on `sale.order` with domain [["partner_id", "=", {partner_id}]] to review recent quotes and confirmed sales orders. 3. Call `odoo_search_read` on `account.move` with domain [["partner_id", "=", {partner_id}]] to assess lifetime invoicing and payment discipline. 4. Synthesize findings into: - Total Lifetime Revenue - Average Order Value & Purchase Frequency - Payment Reliability & Credit Risk - Recommended Commercial Next Steps
Sales Pipeline & Conversion Velocity Analysis
sales_pipeline_insights
Review open sales opportunities, deal velocity, and revenue forecast.

Analyze current sales pipeline dynamics in Odoo: 1. Call `odoo_search_read` on `sale.order` with domain [["state", "in", ["draft", "sent"]]] and order "amount_total desc", limit {limit}. 2. Group pending quotes by salesperson (`user_id`) and customer (`partner_id`). 3. Identify top 5 highest-value pending deals and any quotes exceeding 14 days without customer confirmation. 4. Recommend immediate follow-up tactics to accelerate pipeline closing.
Enterprise Database Data Quality & Hygiene Audit
database_hygiene_audit
Comprehensive data quality inspection checking for duplicates, missing fields, and contact anomalies.

Perform a comprehensive data hygiene audit on model `{model}`: 1. Call `odoo_inspect_data_quality` on model `{model}` with all standard checks. 2. Review duplicate clusters and identify high-risk duplicates sharing identical emails, phones, or VAT numbers. 3. Check missing business fields and note high-impact data omissions. 4. Review format anomalies (malformed emails or phone numbers). 5. Provide a prioritization plan for data deduplication and cleanup.
Aged Receivables & Cash Collection Strategy
financial_aged_summary
Evaluate overdue customer receivables across aging brackets (Current, 1-30, 31-60, 61-90, 90+ days) and prioritize cash recovery.

Analyze customer accounts receivable aging and cash collection priorities: 1. Call `odoo_aged_partner_balance` with `account_type="receivable"` and `top_partners={top_partners}`. 2. Review the overall aging distribution across brackets: Not Due, 1-30, 31-60, 61-90, and 90+ days. 3. Identify the top delinquent customers and examine their oldest unpaid invoices. 4. Prepare an executive cash collection strategy with specific outreach steps for delinquent accounts.
Stale Leads & CRM Activity Audit
lead_pipeline_review
Audit CRM leads for overdue activities, uncontacted prospects, and pipeline bottlenecks.

Perform an audit of active CRM sales leads: 1. Call `odoo_get_activities` with `overdue_only=true` to find sales follow-ups that have missed their deadline. 2. Call `odoo_search_read` on `crm.lead` with domain [["type", "=", "opportunity"], ["probability", "<", 100], ["date_deadline", "<", "today"]] to discover overdue deals. 3. Summarize sales reps with the most stalled deals and recommend next steps.
Design & Deploy Executive Board Dashboard
create_executive_dashboard
Preview and deploy multi-column Odoo board dashboards with embedded pivot tables, charts, and direct redirect links.

Design and deploy a comprehensive executive dashboard in Odoo: 1. Call `odoo_get_model_schema` on `{model}` to identify core metrics and grouping dimensions. 2. FIRST STAGE (Interactive Preview): Call `odoo_create_dashboard` with name="{name}", model="{model}", dashboard_type="spreadsheet", confirm=false. 3. Display the interactive side-screen preview (HTML Artifact / Canvas) using the returned `preview_html` / `dashboard_preview.html`, alongside the in-chat preview showing KPI scorecards with live database figures, monthly trend chart, and top records tables. Ask the user if they would like to make any adjustments. 4. SECOND STAGE (Confirm & Deploy): Once the user approves or confirms, call `odoo_create_dashboard` with name="{name}", model="{model}", dashboard_type="spreadsheet", confirm=true. 5. Provide the clickable direct redirect links (`web_url` / `local_url`) so the user can immediately open and interact with their new dashboard in Odoo.
